# Trade Funding

> Trade Funding is an Australian finance broker (Australian Credit Licence 387856, AFCA member) based in Sydney. Its Cashper compare engine qualifies a business across a panel of 70+ lenders (banks, non-banks, fintechs and private credit providers) and returns a ranked Compare Report, with no credit check until the customer chooses to proceed.

Trade Funding has three channels: Commercial Funding for businesses, Trade Funding Connect for suppliers who want to offer their customers payment options, and Personal & Property Funding for business owners personally.

## Commercial Funding

- [Commercial Funding](https://tradefunding.com.au/commercial/): compare qualified business funding options, for new funding or to review an existing facility
- [Business products](https://tradefunding.com.au/commercial/products/): term loans, lines of credit, overdrafts, charge cards, asset, trade, invoice and cash-flow finance
- [Compare Report](https://tradefunding.com.au/commercial/compare-report/): what the report contains and how options are ranked
- [Guides](https://tradefunding.com.au/commercial/guides/): plain-English guides to business finance products
- [Business Loan Calculator](https://tradefunding.com.au/commercial/business-loan-calculator/)
- [Equipment Finance Calculator](https://tradefunding.com.au/commercial/equipment-calculator/)

## Trade Funding Connect

- [Trade Funding Connect](https://tradefunding.com.au/connect/): a free QR code that gives a supplier's customers qualified payment options on quotes and invoices
- [How Connect works](https://tradefunding.com.au/connect/how-it-works/)
- [Connect FAQs](https://tradefunding.com.au/connect/faqs/)

## Personal & Property Funding

- [Personal & Property Funding](https://tradefunding.com.au/personal-and-property/): home, investment property, vehicle and personal finance for business owners
- [Personal & Property products](https://tradefunding.com.au/personal-and-property/products/)
